body:
## Change

F1. Anchor arrow navigation to existing activeKey, not always player's selectedKey. Opponent-seat navigation now moves relative to opponent deck in displayed legal order.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN captured for opponent ArrowUp. Parent reviewed activeKey derivation and host routing; reran 29 component tests plus production-component Chromium scenario: 1 passed. Worker related: 148; contracts: 87; typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed.

## Limits

L1. Isolated production DeckSelectScreen browser proof; no whole-app asset bootstrap. CI has sampled acquisition-stage failures; no full-CI-green claim.
title: fix(deck-select): navigate from active seat deck
